pr_title: Test: dac : fixing ci failure for rd_rw612_bga and frdm_mcx947
pr_body:
add dts and dac setting for tests/driver/dac/dac_api, tested on both platform

Fixes #70814
pr_comments: the build failure is due to BOARD_ESP32S2_DEVKITC has the same issue ping the owner already.

>the build failure is due to BOARD_ESP32S2_DEVKITC has the same issue ping the owner already.

PR #73015 submitted
I think we don't need another `ESP32-S2` board under tests. The `saola` and `devkitc` boards are identical from the DAC standpoint.

> I think we don't need another `ESP32-S2` board under tests. The `saola` and `devkitc` boards are identical from the DAC standpoint.

the CI will be triggerred by <board>.yaml settings, which is good to autmaticaly extend test coverage
